observations.maintenance.reason.replaced: Untrusted value replaced a trusted fact
observations.maintenance.recheck.intro: The cheap model rechecks flagged notes against recent shared conversations and tasks. Still true renews a note as a model confirmation, trust unchanged; possibly stale comes to you; unclear is tried again the next day. An untrusted value that replaced a trusted fact always comes to you.
observations.maintenance.recheck.off: Automatic recheck is off for this workspace.

observations.maintenance.revalidate.intr: Flags change nothing bots receive. Still true renews the note without changing its trust; forget, undo or confirm it from the list above.
